newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: N.Zealand introduces world's first glowing beer tap.
newsitem.headline: N.Zealand introduces world's first glowing beer tap.

text.p: New Zealand is within a month of introducing a major innovation to the beer industry -- glowing beer tap handles.
"This is the first time in the world that there's been an illuminated tap handle without the aid of wires," Richard Hunter, owner of Christchurch-based Screen Sign Arts, told Reuters on Friday.

Brewer Lion Nathan is to start trials of the handles in selected pubs within a month. Until now, it has not been possible to light beer handles because of the danger of running electric wires close to liquid.

But Hunter's unlisted company has married advanced lighting technology with electricity-transmission science developed at the University of Auckland to allow the safe illumination of screen-printed phosphor lamps embossed in the handles.
The so-called "beacon of the bar" is lit by a 24-volts of electricity transmitted into the handle from a power source inside the tap mounting.
